result:
The build passes cleanly (`ios/` is gitignored as expected). App shell for Phase 1 is implemented and verified:

- `App.tsx` wires up `@react-navigation/native-stack` with three screens
- `screens/HomeScreen.tsx` — title, subtitle, Health/Transcribe buttons
- `screens/HealthScreen.tsx` and `screens/TranscribeScreen.tsx` — placeholder status lines, buttons (one disabled), empty states, matching spec labels exactly
- `components/Button.tsx` — shared styled button
- `navigation/types.ts` — stack param list
- Added `@react-navigation/native`, `@react-navigation/native-stack`, `react-native-screens`, `react-native-safe-area-context` via `npx expo install`

Back navigation to Home is provided by the native-stack header's default back button on both feature screens. `npx expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild ... build` completed with `** BUILD SUCCEEDED **`.
